title: My character had no mouth, so generative AI found another way for it to communicate.
author: TheFrandroid
selftext:
Hey everyone. I decided my hero in [You vs Zombies](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4224660/YOU_vs_Zombies/) should look like a lava lamp. That meant it had no face and then of course no mouth. I figured the lava could somehow become words, so I told the 'ritual' to do this - but the AI went one better and throughout the narrative sections of the game, it described the lava lamps wax as turning into smiley faces, exclamations and short statements to describe how it was feeling.   
Here are some of Lava Lamps amazing narratives! 😅

\*SCALDING HEAT SPIKES AS WAX SPELLS TIME TO FRY\*

\*PINK BLOBS SURGE INTO SIZZLING DANGER SYMBOLS\*

The glowing wax boils up fast to form the words: LET THEM BURN!
